Name: Spouses Move Out
Author: Androxilogin
Description:
It always bothered me how when you get married to a resident that their items just seem to duplicate and appear in your house. This mod will empty out and change the previous living spaces of spouses upon marriage. This mod requires the latest version of [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/SMAPI/]SMAPI[/url],[s] [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/resources/smapi-advanced-location-loader.3619/]Advanced Location Loader[/url] and [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/resources/entoarox-framework.4228/]Entoarox Framework[/url][/s] [b]Content Patcher.[/b]

[b][UPDATE 05/28/21-2] - [/b]Added Maru and Shane. I think that's all of them? Note: The old Advanced Location Loader did many other things I still need to figure out, such as adding the minigames to the home consoles of Shane and Abigail and also removing footprints left by Shane on rainy days as well as cleaning up at certain times. Please do let me know if you're facing any issues.

[b][UPDATE 05/28/21] - [/b]Newest version should be working with: [b]Abigail, Alex, Emily, Haley, Sam, Leah, Sebastian, Elliot, Penny, Harvey [/b]so far. I've only tested a few so let me know of any issues that may arise. Currently working on the rest of the characters. I may have to write some new code here as well since there have since been new candidates since I've last messed around with the game.

[b][UPDATE 05/27/21] - [/b]It has been many a year since I have updated this mod. I'm in the process of migrating it all over to the new [b]Content Patcher[/b] since Advanced Location Loader & Entoarox Framework are long gone. At the moment, the current upload only supports Abigail. Her drumset doesn't work, her hamster doesn't move and her SNES is broke again, unfortunately. I don't believe Content Patcher supports these actions so if I do end up adding them back into the mod it will most likely require an outside framework. 
 [b] [/b]
[b][UPDATE 03/23/17] - [/b]New version 1.2 added! What's new? Well I'll tell ya! 

[list]
[*]Abigail's drumset works!
[*]Abigail's hamster is alive again!
[*]Abigail's SNES works!
[*]Sam's Keyboard works!
[*]Shane's Genesis works!
[*]Shane only drinks on Fridays!
[*]Shane's footprints will only appear when it's raining!
[/list]The flooring outside of your spouse's room will now also match their floor regardless of what spouse you have!
Also cleaned up the code quite a bit.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/tubRJfu.png[/img] 

[b][i]Not available from stardewmods.com or stardewvalleymods.net - Ever![/i][/b]


[b][UPDATE] - 01/25/17 - [/b]No more overrides needed! - This was used as a quick workaround for the previous AdvancedLocationLoader. Update includes fixes and more stuff! To ensure you have the latest version (or to post a question, etc. with the fastest response time), please refer to [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/spouses-move-out.128164/]this thread[/url].

[b][UPDATE] - 01/16/17 - [/b]New version v.0.11 added that is compatible with all bachelors/bachelorettes including Abigail & Maru. Note that these changes may not take effect if you're already married- I haven't tested this yet but I've tested all characters and they worked correctly. There are still a few tile changes here and there I plan to change in the next version but this was stable so I figured why not set it off in the wild. Contains map overrides to make it function properly due to some set backs. So if you use replacement files for AnimalShop, HaleyHouse, HarveyRoom, JoshHouse, LeahHouse, SamHouse, ScienceHouse, SebastianRoom, SeedShop or Trailer maps, they will most likely be thrown on the back-burner and replaced with one of these files. If you're using the mod, [i][url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/wip-yet-even-more-map-edits-make-sv-more-immersive.127523/http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/wip-yet-even-more-map-edits-make-sv-more-immersive.127523/]Yet, Even More Map Edits[/url][/i] by [b][url=http://community.playstarbound.com/members/karmylla.637910/]Karmylla[/url][/b] there is a different version for that.
